checks: if [ -z "$BRINDLE_BASE_BRANCH" ] || ! git diff --quiet "$BRINDLE_BASE_BRANCH"...HEAD -- app; then cd app && { test -d node_modules || npm ci --silent; } && npx vitest run && npx tsc -b; fi
rules: Full coverage is not a goal. Features need a main-path test, plus a failure path only when it matters; bug fixes need one regression test that fails on base and passes after. Refactors, renames, docs, config, wording and pure glue need no new tests. Extend existing tests or tables first. Never test wording, constants, defaults or mock arguments. Missing feature or regression tests and added tests catching no distinct bug are blockers.
